'''catman421 Agents In The Court (AITC) (Jawas V2)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 30 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Court catman421 LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The second version of Jawas.  Much improved.

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

---Responces---

[will be filled in as necessary]

---Basic Strategy---

Control Tatooine.  Use the small space force to control Tatooine and run Celebration.  Plenty of tech.

---Card Choices---

Kalit-

Rep.  All jawas are power +2 while hes @ the AC.

Tauntaun Bones (V)-

Pull Worrts from under Effect.  Eliminate opponent's characters in an AC where there isnt any battles.

Wokling (V)-

Extra Activation.  Pulls effects.

Strike Planning-

Pulls Rieekan.  Major Tech.

Luke Skywalker (V), Boshek (V)-

Put in Artoo In Red 5.  Luke retrieves during control phase.

General Carlist Rieekan (V)-

Pulled by Strike Planning.  Pulls Golan guns and powers them.  More firepower where needed.  Best @ the Entrance Cavern.

Aved Luun-

Pulls Jawas and Utinni!.  Play lots of Jawas to get minor drain protection.

Uutkik-

Jawa and thief.  Can steal opponent's vehicles, weapons and devices from their lost pile.

Thedit-

Powerful Jawa.  Adds a battle destiny and reduces opponent's attrition.

Arleil Schous-

Pulls a jawa and reduces deploy costs of jawas.

Tessek-

Reduces deploy costs. Adds to force drains.

Jawa-

Coruscant version.

Space-

I tried to keep things simple.  only one ship requires a pilot.  Very powerful stuff.

Tatooine-

Coruscant version.  Limits opponenst's battle destinies.

Tatooine: Jabba's Palace-

Got to have the headquarters.  Potental damage causer (if opponent is playing a Palace deck).

Jabba's Palace:  Entrance Cavern-

Exterior / Interior site.  Best location for golan guns.

Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber-

Kalit's base.  Protected by Bo Shuda.

Mindful Of The Future-

Pulls locations.  High destiny.

The Signal-

Pulls effects.  High destiny.

Advance Prep (V)-

Death Star protection via stuff under starting effect.

Utinni (V)-

Pulls jawas.  Cancels drains if Aved Luun's ability is activated.

Rebel Artillery-

Huge destiny (7).  Does damage too.

Yarna d'a' Gargan-

Monnok protection.  High destiny.

Jawa Siesta-

Boosts forfiet of all Jawas.

Jawa Siesta (V)-

Adds to power of unique jawas and adds a destiny to power.

The Camp-

Adds to opponent's deploy costs for aliens.

Tatooine Celebration-

Constant retrevial.

Sandwhirl-

Causes problems for those outside.  [evil laugh]

Bo Shuda-

Stops battles and drains at the AC.

Uh-Oh!-

Keeps Bo Shuda around.

Golan Laser Battery-

Pulled and powered by Rieekan.  Fires to same or adjacnet sites.

Get the Palace set up and drain away.
